cohort: The study included 418 women who had undergone one previous cesarean section.
finding: Among 268 women who attempted TOLAC, the VBAC success rate was 39.20%, with success factors including older maternal age, a longer interval since the last CS, and a history of previous vaginal delivery or VBAC.
mod_finding: VBAC demonstrated a 39.20% success rate among those attempting TOLAC, with success being associated with older maternal age, a longer interval since the last CS, and a history of previous vaginal delivery or VBAC.
